posts.description: A Portrait of Terence Hammonds Made for the Cincinnati Art Museum outside of his new exhibition, which opened to the public today.

New View I wanted to illustrate the relationship between the Art Museum and downtown. The two often feel so apart from one another, and I knew there was probably a way to show them side by side if I got up to the right angle. This is what I managed to come up with while flying. I genuinely think this is my favorite image I've ever made of the museum.

Changing Course I needed to get a photo of a ground mural in a weird spot along Artist Alley in Pendleton for 1001 Colors. When I got there, though, the shadows were simply too harsh, and I ended up not being able to get the photo after all.
